subject.title: fix: A2A handoffs can duplicate message-tool replies

question: Should OpenClaw accept this waited A2A artifact-suppression boundary for message-tool mirror and inter-session transcript rows before merge?
rationale: The code and proof look strong, but the PR intentionally changes which transcript rows can produce visible A2A replies, and green CI cannot fully settle every real channel history.

options.title: Accept Boundary
options.body: Proceed with this PR after exact-head gates because the change is narrow and the Gateway/QA proof targets the duplicate visible-message failure mode.

options.title: Request Live Channel Proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted live WhatsApp or equivalent channel run if maintainer confidence requires production-channel evidence beyond the deterministic QA harness.

options.title: Defer To Broader A2A Work
options.body: Pause this PR only if maintainers want the reverse-send, return-path, and compaction-related duplicate fixes resolved under one coordinated A2A delivery decision.

recommendation.title: Accept Boundary
recommendation.body: Proceed with this PR after exact-head gates because the change is narrow and the Gateway/QA proof targets the duplicate visible-message failure mode.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent has the strongest recent history on delivery-mirror transcript provenance and adjacent sessions_send reply handling.
